title: A320 OANS
creator: Free Airport Mapping DB, from FlyByWire Simulations' A380X OANS

neutral.LastUpdate: An airport moving map (OANS) on the Fenix A320's captain navigation display: FlyByWire's A380X OANS, with its map data panel, context menu, flags and crosses, fed by AMDB Bridge. Turn the ND range knob below 10 to show it. Its aircraft instrument also feeds live position to the standalone browser map. GPL-3.0; see README.txt.
